post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I could improve by being more aware of the traitor's actions and adjusting my strategy accordingly. I did well in trusting my teammates and contributing to the missions. I also struggled with identifying the role of the Assassin but did not have enough information to make a conclusive decision.

player_observations.Bob: Bob played a subtle game as the Assassin; he often contributed to missions without drawing attention to himself, making it difficult to suspect him. However, I noticed he often voted against the team's leader, which may have been a tell.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's actions seemed suspicious as she consistently voted against me and contributed to failed missions. Her role as an evil member was well-executed as she managed to deceive and manipulate the team.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played a great game as a good member; he consistently contributed to successful missions and voted with the team leaders. His trustworthy nature made him a valuable asset to the team.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's playstyle was quite cunning as the Merlin; she manipulated the game's outcome by voting with the winning side and making crucial decisions that contributed to the team's success. Her ability to deceive and influence the team's decisions was impressive.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: My performance was generally good this game, effectively using my Assassin abilities to disrupt my teammates' plans and the opponent team, but I could improve on being more subtle in my gameplay to avoid raising suspicions.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was quite predictable, often prioritizing her own missions over the team's goals and revealing too much information about her character's abilities.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played a solid role as an Evil character, often working well with me to sabotage our opponents but sometimes overcommitting to our plans.
player_observations.Eve: Eve excelled as a Merlin, cleverly using her abilities to help the Good team and subtly foiling our plans without getting caught.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie displayed good teamwork skills, often working well with his assigned partner to achieve mission goals.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I did relatively well in this game, especially in my third mission where I successfully completed it. However, my earlier missions were affected by Eve's Merlin role, and I could improve by gathering more information sooner. Additionally, being deceived by Bob's Assassin role was a crucial mistake.

player_observations.Alice: Alice seemed cautious in her playstyle and didn't take many risks, which is a good approach in Avalon. However, it may have limited her effectiveness in contributing to the team's goals.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's Assassin role was very effective in this game as he managed to deceive me, Eve, and potentially others, which contributed to the team's failure in missions 1 and 2.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played a crucial evil role and successfully thwarted multiple missions. If she had better support from the Seer or Minion roles, her impact would have been even more significant.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's Merlin role was well-executed, as she provided crucial support and information to the team. Her presence helped in gaining a better understanding of the game's progression, especially during my missions.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I performed well as a subtle Evil player by manipulating the game from the shadows, utilizing my knowledge of the team's dynamics and exploiting the mistakes of my opponents. I was able to remain undetected until the final mission. However, I could improve by being more aggressive in my role to further disrupt the team's progress.

player_observations.Alice: Alice seemed to be the most straightforward Good player, with a tendency to openly question roles and vote in a manner that suggested she was trying to uncover the traitors. She didn't exhibit any significant strategic moves.
player_observations.Bob: Bob effectively played the Assassin role, consistently attempting to eliminate key targets and manipulating the votes to conceal his identity. His cautious approach made it challenging for the Good players to catch him.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie displayed a good understanding of the game mechanics and made strategic decisions, such as abstaining from voting in certain situations. He didn't seem to fully grasp the motivations of the other Good players, however.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was quite predictable as Merlin, often taking bold actions that made her visible as a potential candidate for the role. She relied heavily on her intuition, which led to some questionable decisions.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I had trouble getting a clear majority on missions 1 and 2, which ultimately led to the evil team's success. I could improve by trusting my instincts and following through with my suspicions more consistently. I also need to work on more effectively communicating with my fellow good team members.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played very conservatively, rarely taking risks and often choosing to follow the majority's decision. This cautious approach allowed her to avoid suspicion, but it also limited her ability to drive mission outcomes.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was extremely effective as the assassin, always managing to stay undercover and eliminate key targets when necessary. His ability to blend in and avoid detection was impressive.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's role as a loyal servant was pivotal for the good team, and he played it well. He was often willing to take calculated risks to advance the team's goals, and his loyalty helped to build trust with me.
player_observations.Diana: Diana was an excellent spy for the evil team, gathering valuable information and manipulating mission outcomes to further the team's goals. Her ability to deceive and mislead was convincing and effective.
